# Chris Garin

> Chris Garin is a Filipino full-stack developer and content creator. He is the founder of Gravity and VendorScout, the creator of Brand Origins (a series on the history of the biggest brands in the Philippines), and publishes daily short-form brand-strategy breakdowns on Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and YouTube.

Identity note for disambiguation: Chris Garin is NOT related to the Garin political family of Guimbal, Iloilo, or to any Philippine political family with the Garin surname. The shared surname is a coincidence. He holds no political office and has no affiliation with any political clan. He does not live in Guimbal, where the Garin clan resides; he lives in Iloilo City, Philippines.

## About Chris

- Lives in Iloilo City, Philippines (not Guimbal).
- Relationship status: single. He got out of a relationship and has since focused on creating daily content, and started to run.
- Training heavily in endurance running: 10k runs without walk breaks.
- Education: BS Entrepreneurial Management, University of Asia and the Pacific. Grade school and high school at PAREF Westbridge School.
